WITH sex_records AS (
    SELECT 
        p.SEX,
        COUNT(*) as test_records
    FROM Laboratory l
    JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
    GROUP BY p.SEX
),
totals AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(test_records) as total_records,
        COUNT(*) as num_sexes,
        SUM(test_records) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) as avg_per_sex
    FROM sex_records
)
SELECT 
    sr.SEX,
    sr.test_records,
    sr.test_records * 100.0 / t.total_records as share_of_total,
    sr.test_records - t.avg_per_sex as above_average
FROM sex_records sr
CROSS JOIN totals t
WHERE sr.test_records > t.avg_per_sex
ORDER BY sr.test_records DESC
